Several weeks (1000 War Exp in repeatable missions) + ≈1 hour to climb the tower

To receive the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits|Insectoid Outfits} you have to do the missions of the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest|War Against the Hive Quest} for {npc:Orockle} and help open the hive ({wiki:Hive Born World Change|Hive Born World Change}). With enough War Exp you buy a pheromone, climb to the top of the Hive's west tower and use the {item:Insectoid Remains} to receive the outfit and addons, plus the achievement **Bane of the Hive**.
